name: B10-0415/2025 (The Left) – Situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the Taliban, who run Afghanistan, to restore women's and girls' rights to education, healthcare and work, and to stop violence and arrests against women. It asks the European Union to give more aid after the August 2025 earthquakes, with priority for women and girls. It also asks European countries to stop deporting Afghans and to offer safe legal routes. The text is a statement of opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- The Taliban are urged to reopen women's rights, but the text cannot force this.
- The European Union is asked to send more earthquake aid focused on women and girls.
- European countries are asked to halt deportations and accept Afghans at risk.
